title: Econ Sculptor: Field Lab Rollout & Checklist for Batching/Caching/Quant Profiles
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Goal: Run a tightly scoped field experiment to validate combined batching + KV-prefetch + quantization profiles against real traffic, capture savings and quality trade-offs, and produce an operational rollout checklist. This ticket coordinates PM workstreams: hypothesis definition, cohort selection, rollout scheduler, telemetry dashboards, and rollback criteria. Scope is limited to 3 internal pilot customers and one public beta team; no global defaults will change until signoff.

Why now: Multiple small experiments have shown single-knob wins (batching or quant) but not combined effects on latency tail and user-visible quality. We need a repeatable runbook to ship safe, measurable savings across Dedicated and Hosted modes.

Non-goal: full company-wide enforcement or A/B API changes. This is a field lab and playbook draft for ops and SRE to adopt in subsequent releases.
acceptance_criteria: Field lab executed across 3 cohorts representing low/medium/high token-length distributions
Telemetry dashboard (prefetch + batch + quant) shows per-cohort: tokens-per-second, cost-per-1M-tokens, p50/p95 latency, and generation-quality regression metric
Savings signal verified: >= 15% cost reduction on at least two cohorts without exceeding quality thresholds
Runbook & rollout checklist documented and reviewed by SRE, Runtime, and Security
Canary and rollback automation hooks implemented in Console and tested end-to-end
tasks: Define hypotheses and QoR (quality of response) regression thresholds with Research
Select 3 pilot customers and obtain consent; map traffic profiles
Create experiment configs: batching policies, KV prefetch TTLs, quant profiles per model family
Implement telemetry: tag requests, expose cost per-route, and add quality delta hooks
Ship canary gating in Console: percent rollout, duration timers, automatic rollback criteria
Run internal dry-run on synthetic traffic and fix instrumentation gaps
Execute 2-week field lab, gather signals, and run offline evals against golden prompts
Synthesize results, write runbook, and prepare rollout recommendation memo
milestones: 2025-02-20: Experiment configs committed and infra tickets created
2025-03-08: Field lab ends; analysis draft ready
metrics: Cost impact: percent change in tokens-per-dollar and projected annualized savings
Latency: p50 and p95 generation latency change
Quality: weighted prompt set pass rate and human-rated regression delta
Reliability: error rate and incidence of fallback model activations
Adoption: percent of routes/teams opting into recommended profiles after pilot
risks: Quality regression for specific prompt families not covered by evaluation set
Telemetry gaps leading to misattribution of savings to unrelated infra changes
Unanticipated request amplification when batching combines multi-turn sessions
Insufficient pilot diversity resulting in biased savings estimate
Coordination friction with Dedicated ops windows and customer maintenance schedules
